title: YData Profiling Report Schema
description: A documented schema describing the structure and meaning of fields in a ydata-profiling JSON report.

analysis.description: Title of the Profile Report and start date and end date of report generation

date_start.description: Timestamp indicating when the profiling analysis started, in 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.ssssss' format

date_end.description: Timestamp indicating when the profiling analysis completed, in 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.ssssss' format

time_index_analysis.description: Optional time index analysis summary. Null if time index was toggled off.

table.description: Summary statistics on the data in the table.

n.description: Total number of records in the dataset.

n_var.description: Total number of columns (variables) in the dataset.

memory_size.description: Memory consumption of the entire dataset in bytes.

record_size.description: Average memory size per record (row) in bytes.

n_cells_missing.description: Total number of missing cells across the entire dataset.

n_vars_with_missing.description: Number of variables (columns) that contain at least one missing value.

n_vars_all_missing.description: Number of variables (columns) where all values are missing.

p_cells_missing.description: Proportion of missing cells across the dataset (n_cells_missing / n_cells).

types.description: Counts of variables by detected high-level type.

additionalProperties.description: Number of variables of this type (e.g., Numeric, Categorical, Boolean).

n_duplicates.description: Number of duplicated rows in the dataset.

variables.description: A mapping of column names to their profiling statistics.
variables.$comment: Each key in this object is a column name from the dataset.

additionalProperties.description: Profiling statistics for a single column.

type.description: Detected data type of the column (e.g., 'Numeric', 'Categorical', 'Boolean').

n.description: Total number of rows in the column.

n_distinct.description: Number of distinct values in the column.

n_unique.description: Number of values that appear exactly once in the column.

is_unique.description: Whether every value in the column is unique.
is_unique.$comment: Equivalent to checking if n_distinct == n. Indicates a potential primary key.

p_unique.description: Proportion of values that appear exactly once (n_unique / n).

n_missing.description: Number of missing values in the column.

memory_size.description: Estimated memory footprint of the column in bytes.

hashable.description: Whether the column's values can be hashed (important for set operations).
